purpose: Publish only complete, independently evaluated role routes to the possible-agent roster while the remaining reusable block library is built.

statuses.READY: The complete block set is source-locked, independently evaluated, and eligible for Controller consideration.
statuses.NOT_READY: A required block, source lock, fixture, or evaluation is missing; the route is never admitted.
statuses.UNKNOWN: Evidence is insufficient; the route is never admitted.

projection_rule: Omitted and non-ready routes remain pending. Available role request IDs and available wave IDs are the only routes the Controller may consider. A block update invalidates dependent seeds and requires a fresh projection. wave_activation_allowed is an explicit typed execution constraint: when true, complete waves are activatable; when false, complete waves move to activation_blocked_wave_ids and are not exposed as available. Pending local block routes take precedence over a held wave. next_action must be START_NEXT_AVAILABLE_CONTROLLER_TRANSITION, START_NEXT_LOCAL_BLOCK_REPAIR, WAIT_FOR_PROTECTED_WAVE_ACTIVATION, or PREPARE_DEVELOPMENT_CANDIDATE_REVIEW according to the projection.
controller_rule: The Controller starts the first available complete wave immediately only when wave_activation_allowed is true. When activation is held and pending local blocks exist, it starts the exact next local block repair instead of claiming a wave transition. A routine closeout must bind the exact next transition or local block-repair action from the same projection; it must not wait for a timer or an additional wave-decision prompt. It must not infer readiness from a role name, static registry count, commentary, or an opaque digest.
admission_rule: incomplete_never_admitted=true; no seed or working agent is spawned from NOT_READY or UNKNOWN routes.
zero_trace_rule: The projection is control-plane state and never enters Product source.
protected_stall_rule: STALLED_READY_FOR_RESUMPTION is valid only when no available, activation-blocked, or pending local route remains and the closeout names one sole protected dependency. A held wave with no pending local route uses a typed protected-wave-activation continuation. Utility/harm pending alone never freezes local block work.
